title: Content unit set frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of presentations/<slug>/units.md. The body carries one ## u### section per unit, each opening with a flat key/value list validated against $defs/unit.
$comment: Per-unit keys live in the body, not in frontmatter, because Decision 2 forbids maps in frontmatter. validate.mjs parses each ## u### block and validates it against $defs/unit.

extracted_from.description: Context files the units were decomposed from, repo-relative.

unit_count.description: Number of ## u### sections in the body. validate.mjs checks the count.

uid.description: Unit id, unique within the deck. The body heading is ## <uid>.

slide_function.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/slide_function.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
slide_function.description: Layer 1 (research/06 §b): the structural role of the slide this unit belongs on.

unit_type.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/unit_type.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
unit_type.description: Layer 2 (research/06 §b): what the fragment rhetorically is.

shape.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/shape.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
shape.description: Layer 3 (research/06 §b): the modality the unit wants. Binds only to a layout whose content_shape contains it.

items.description: Count of repeated children (bullets, steps, tiles, rows). 0 for a single-part unit.

chars.description: Total characters of the unit text; compared against a layout text_capacity_chars.

has_number.description: True when the unit carries a quantity that could fill a number role.

evidence_kind.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/evidence_kind.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
evidence_kind.description: Kind of proof this unit offers. "none" when the unit is not evidence.

importance.description: Operator or extractor priority, 1 lowest. Drives what gets dropped when the slide budget binds.

must_include.description: True when the deck fails acceptance if this unit is unplaced (Skill 1 acceptance).

section.description: Top-level source section this unit came from; section dividers are inserted at these boundaries (research/06 §d).
